name: launch_specialist
description: Launch an allowlisted Waykit specialist as a host Task/subagent. Pass specialist id, capability class, Linear ticket if any, previous handover paths, Definition of Done, and Next agent. Do not pass a vendor model slug. Do not launch stack profiles. Do not split TDD gear 1 and gear 2.

class.description: Optional capability class from models/catalog.yaml (resolve via wk model resolve --skill)

ticket.description: Linear id when playing a ticket, e.g. WAY-123

handoverPaths.description: Previous handover files the child must read

definitionOfDone.description: Phase Definition of Done the child must meet before COMPLETE

nextAgent.description: Recommended next role skill after this child writes the handover
